sanskrit_verse:
सभीको ग्राहकस्तत्र दद्याज्जेत्रे नृपाय च ।
राजवृद्धिः सकितवात् सभिकाद्दशकं शतम् ॥
transliteration: sabhiko grāhakas tatra dadyāj jetre nṛpāya ca | rājavṛddhiḥ sakitavāt sabhikād daśakaṃ śatam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The Sabhika shall offer a gift to the king upon victory; from the Sabhika's wealth, ten percent shall be rendered to the King for royal augmentation.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from active participation in governance
Causation arises through benefit received under royal protection
Capacity-based responsibility aligns with economic engagement
Restoration logic ensures circulation of prosperity within Dharma
Consciousness alignment manifests through voluntary offering
executable_legal_axioms: IF entity 'Sabhika' receives benefit under royal protection THEN allocate 10% of gain to sovereign authority
IF victory or acquisition occurs THEN trigger proportional contribution protocol
IF economic capacity increases THEN initiate automatic alignment transfer to state treasury
IF transaction involves public domain THEN enforce completion via designated fiscal interface
IF resource accumulation exceeds threshold THEN activate conscious redistribution mechanism
supreme_court_application: In adjudication at the highest level, this verse establishes that economic actors who derive value from state-enabled structures must contribute proportionally without punitive enforcement. The court must ensure alignment between private gain and sovereign continuity by activating automated contribution protocols rooted in Dharma rather than coercive taxation.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is established through visible benefit derived under royal order. Anupūrvaśaḥ unfolds as natural consequence of participation in structured society. Proportional responsibility reflects integrity of exchange. Non-punitive reality rule confirms that all contributions arise from recognition of mutual dependence, not compulsion.

Integrity reintegration through transparent ledger-based contribution system

Dharma stands restored through conscious alignment. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness reigns as ultimate adjudicator.
